$comment: Lycaon's own host schema. It is NOT part of the Open Agent Rules standard: the standard's vendored schemas live in schemas/oar/ and are never edited here. This one describes this engine's anchor catalog and binding grammar, which the format does not specify.
title: AnchorCatalog
description: Anchor catalog SSOT. Named lifecycle moments with typed Envelopes. lycaon/config/packs/painted-wolf/platform/host/anchors/catalog.yaml validates against this schema. Emit uses catalog-validated ids (MustAnchor / string + contract).

schema_version.description: Catalog document version (MAJOR.MINOR). Bump minor for additive anchors; major for id renames/removals.

id.description: Stable dotted lifecycle-moment id (e.g. leg.finished, tool.pre_invoke, gate.blocked).

title.description: Short human label for docs and authoring UIs.

description.description: When this moment fires (machine-state terms only).

surface.description: Emit surface. agent = shared coordinator/worker moment; phase = phase-bound workflow/topology moment.

dedup.description: Default dedup/suppression policy for Bindings on this anchor. Subsumes SignalEvent + ComputeSignalSuppression.

planes.description: Which Binding effect planes attach here. Default both when omitted.

triggerClass.description: Closed trigger taxonomy covering host kick classes and OAR coarse lifecycle buckets.

envelope.description: Typed render/fact vars this anchor guarantees in scope when Emit fires. Formalizes what buildKickRenderData / mergeKickPolicyVars produced ad hoc.

vars.description: Map of variable names to type declarations. Templates and conditions may only reference declared variables and the shared OAR fact set.

type.description: Host-assembled type. object/object[] are structured DTOs (e.g. gate_obligations rows).

required.description: When true, Emit must supply the var (fail closed if missing).

dedup.description: Suppression policy when this anchor's inform Binding fires. Replaces SignalEvent rows.

omit_hint_codes.description: Hint codes to suppress when an inform Binding on this anchor is queued.

omit_inform_when.description: Conditions under which inform render is omitted.
